offering_description.value: Independent insurance distributor (formerly BRP Group) that places commercial, personal risk, employee benefits and specialty insurance with carriers for businesses and individuals. It also provides underwriting, managing general agency and consulting services through its agencies and underwriting and technology platform.

primary_services.value: commercial insurance brokerage; personal risk and homeowners insurance placement; employee benefits consulting; managing general agency and underwriting services; insurance technology and program solutions

customer_segment.value: B2B: businesses of all sizes buying property-casualty coverage and employee benefits; B2C: individuals and families buying home, auto, life and health insurance

end_markets.value: commercial insurance; personal insurance; employee benefits; specialty insurance; real estate and construction

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: commissions from insurance carriers on placed policies, plus profit-sharing contingent commissions; service fees: consulting and advisory fees for benefits and risk management
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: places coverage from insurance carriers for commercial and individual clients as broker and managing general agent; software / platform: technology and data platform supporting underwriting and distribution for partner agencies and carriers

geography_served.value: US national: offices across many US states, with clients nationwide

specialization.value: related lines: commercial, personal risk, employee benefits and underwriting/MGA lines all focused on insurance distribution

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: producers and advisors in company-owned agencies selling to clients; agents / brokers: wholesale and MGA programs distributing through independent agents; partners / resellers: real estate, mortgage and homebuilder partners referring personal insurance
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; agents / brokers; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance agency licensing regulated by state insurance departments, benefits subject to ERISA and ACA rules
